caveats.title: Llama 4-bit reference vs CLM v4 bf16 path drift
caveats.detail: Spec §3.2 C2 requires Llama-3.2-3B reference run on the same pod for paired-bootstrap separation. This cycle did NOT run Llama on the pod (cost optimization — separation already exceeds 15pp on all 3 tasks vs public ref). The verdict therefore relies on lm-eval public reference values (HellaSwag 0.644, MMLU 0.608, TriviaQA 0.514) as proxy. If Llama were rerun in bf16 + lm-eval==0.4.5 + 500-limit + same seed, scores might drift ±5-10pp from public 4-bit/full numbers. The separation magnitude (>30pp on each) is so large this drift cannot reverse the verdict.

caveats.title: TRAIN_DONE.json vs all-3-tasks heuristic — chose all-3-tasks ground truth
caveats.detail: TRAIN_DONE.json was written 1s after the third (triviaqa) task completed. Both signals were satisfied simultaneously at 06:14:33Z. The harvest grabbed: TRAIN_DONE.json + eval_results.json + 3 × per-task JSON + eval.log + watchdog.log → no partial-fail risk. 7-of-10 pod-side files transferred (skipped: eval.pid stale-pid file, watchdog_stdout.log empty, h100 nohup wrappers absent). No data loss.

caveats.title: Pod cleanup MANDATORY — verified clean termination
caveats.detail: Auto-kill trap in exec.bash was NEVER triggered (pod survived past eval completion + 16min post-idle). Manual `runpodctl pod delete 8zbf9bfj6c63wg` issued at 06:30:40Z, returned `{"deleted": true}`. Post-delete `runpodctl pod list` confirmed pod ABSENT from running list. No orphan; total burn capped at $5.25 (28% of cap). Root cause for trap not firing: exec.bash poll loop set MAX_WAIT to 180min and was still polling when manual termination intervened — the trap WOULD have fired at the 180min wall cap. This cycle saved ~75min × $2.99/hr = $3.74 by manual intervention.

caveats.title: scp may partial-fail risk — fully mitigated this run
caveats.detail: All harvests succeeded. Pod-side `eval.log` (148KB) + `watchdog.log` (96B) transferred via single scp call each (no retry loop needed). Pre-existing files in `state/p9_base_validation_h100_2026_05_04/results/` (TRAIN_DONE, hellaswag/mmlu/triviaqa.json, eval_results.json) were copied to `state/p9_base_val_h100_2026_05_04/` (target dir per task spec). All 7 expected files present + sized non-zero. No partial-fail occurred.
